Date:  November 4, 2026 
To:  Krystal DeGray  
From: Helayne Talbott, Director of Career and Technical Education 
Re:  Request for Approval to Purchase a Vehicle for Nashua Technology Center 
 
The Career and Technical Education Center is requesting approval to purchase a 15-passenger van at a price of 
$73075.00 for the Nashua Technology Center (NTC) using our CTE Special Revenue Account. This purchase 
would address significant transportation needs within our Career and Technical Education programs and 
provide greater access to meaningful, hands-on learning experiences for our students. 
One of the primary goals of Career and Technical Education is to connect classroom instruction with authentic, 
real-world experiences. Many of our programs rely on opportunities outside the traditional classroom to help 
students develop industry-specific skills, explore career pathways, and prepare for postsecondary education and 
employment. Unfortunately, transportation continues to be a barrier to providing these experiences consistently 
and efficiently. As we continue to strengthen our CTE programs and expand partnerships with local businesses 
and industries, reliable transportation is essential. This investment would directly support student learning, 
increase access to career-connected experiences, and provide a valuable resource across both NTC campuses. 
Currently, our programs often depend on contracted transportation services, which can be costly, difficult to 
schedule, and limited in flexibility. In some cases, transportation expenses and availability restrict the 
opportunities we can provide. Having a dedicated vehicle would allow us to respond more effectively to 
program needs while reducing our reliance on outside transportation providers. 
The purchase would also be accompanied by appropriate district procedures to ensure safe and responsible 
operation. These would include driver approval, motor vehicle record checks, vehicle inspection procedures, 
mileage logs, and established safety and accident protocols. 
Thank you for your continued support of Career and Technical Education and the opportunities it provides to 
students throughout the greater Nashua region. 
Recommendation to approve the purchase of a 15-passenger van from Grappone Ford for use in the CTE 
programs in an amount not to exceed $73,075.00.  Funding to come from the CTE Special Revenue account.

Speech

Middle School during the 26-27 School Year.

a cost not to exceed $84,744.00 for the 2026-2027 school year. 
● Staffing of a part-time Speech Language Pathologist Assistant (SLPA), up to 13 hours/week at 
$77.00/hr, at a cost not to exceed $36,036.00 for the 2026-2027 school year. 
● Total cost of this contract not to exceed $120,780.00 for the 2026-2027 school year.   
● Funding to be charged to the Operating Budget under Out-of-District Tuition.
